invariants.description: Ohmic leak at the Ca Nernst potential; j = -i/(2F) (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(E_Ca, 1000*R*T/(2*F)*np.log(Cao/Cai), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(i_leak_Ca, g_leak_Ca*(V - E_Ca), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_leak_Ca, -i_leak_Ca/(2*F)*1e-9, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: second law: the leak runs down its electrochemical gradient, i (V - E_Ca) >= 0
